Priya A. (AE): VentureCare board pressing for BYOK + EU egress numbers by EOD. Need exec-safe fallback.

Marco R. (Solutions): BYOK via Azure KV for Private. Hosted limited KMS. Egress intra-EU cheaper; cross-region billed per GB. I'll assemble quick numbers.

Li Wei (Eng): For pinned eu-west-1 Dedicated, 2k qps @60 tokens -> p95 ~130ms. I'll run a short perf to confirm.

Tanya G. (Legal): BYOK addendum ok; HSM attestation requires customer docs and may add 48-72h. Drafting provisional language.

Sam S. (SRE): Peering needs ~5 business days. VPN+allowlist possible in ~48h. Mutual TLS needs certs.

Priya A. (AE): Can we offer a 2-week dedicated trial with SLA as fallback? Board wants no blockers.

Finance-bot: Quote request logged. Deliverable: trial discount + 12mo reserved pricing delta. ETA 3h.

Marco R. (Solutions): I'll drop a 1-pager + pricing spreadsheet with attestation surcharge in ~2h.

Priya A. (AE): Owners: Marco=pricing+1pager, Li=perf, Tanya=legal, Sam=network, Finance-bot=quote. 3pm sync. Update thread with infra ticket ID when filed.
